title: Square roots on a prime clock
hook: Square roots on a prime clock.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Integer remainders, gcd, primes, modular exponentiation.
doesNotKnow: Find a modular square root by reducing the power-of-two order of the residual.

misconception: A modular square root can be obtained by ordinary real square rooting and rounding.
objective: Find a modular square root by reducing the power-of-two order of the residual.

claims.text: Tonelli–Shanks splits the group order into an odd part and a power of two. Each correction reduces the residual order until it becomes one, and the final square checks the root certificate.
